en.tashayyu: 66 – Muḥammad b. Aḥmad b. Quḍāʿa b. Ṣafwān b. Mihrān, Abū ʿAbdillāh, al-Ṣafwāni.

I have not disclaimed anything from him except for what he narrates from his father from his grandfather from al-Sadiq  عليه السلام , for it is something unknown and I have seen unrecognized (matters) in it, untrue against/upon him.  And I suspect that the lying was by his father.
